versions.changelog:
- Now measures price changes against a retained alert baseline instead of the immediately previous price, so cumulative moves are required to trigger alerts.
- Only updates the baseline after firing an alert; minor movements do not reset the comparison point.
- Clarified alert logic to improve accuracy and reduce unwanted notifications.
- Removed skill-card.md; all documentation is now in SKILL.md.

Initial release of coin-price-alert skill:

- Monitors a chosen Nodary AirnodeHub crypto feed every five minutes.
- Alerts are triggered only when a 5% or greater price change is detected since the last check.
- Immediate, clear notifications include: feed name, current and previous prices, direction (🔴 decrease, 🟢 increase), percentage change, and timestamp.
- Ensures only explicit, recognized feeds can be monitored; ambiguous selections are clarified before setup.
- No alerts or notifications are issued for changes under 5% or non-numeric data; the reference value is quietly updated.
- Each alert is managed as a distinct OpenClaw job, with options to update or remove without creating duplicates.
